identityChoice.description: The business record remains the organization’s authority. The DTSC account remains the person’s sign-in identity.
identityChoice.manualDescription: The person can exist in your organization without having a DTSC account.
identityChoice.existingTitle: Invite to link a DTSC account
identityChoice.existingDescription: A private invitation will be sent. The relationship remains inactive without explicit consent.
identityChoice.createTitle: Invite to create a DTSC account
identityChoice.createDescription: The person can create an account and then separately decide whether to accept the relationship.
identityChoice.laterDescription: Save the business record first. Linking can be offered later.
identityChoice.linked: Relationship already linked with active consent.
identityChoice.refused: The link was refused. The business record remains available.
identityChoice.revoked: Authorization was withdrawn. No future synchronization is allowed.
